reassessment_reason: Current official Tyler portal evidence establishes named subscriber bulk products, cadences, list-builder pricing, and subscriber-account pricing that were not captured precisely in the September 22 assessment. It still does not establish a usable schema, automation contract, or reuse rights.

access.bulk: The official Tyler portal advertises Business Entity/Corporation Database Bulk Download for subscribers at $2,000 per month with daily, weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly downloads.
access.list_builder: The official Special Request List Builder is advertised at $0.10 per record with a $10 minimum.
access.subscriber_account: The official Arkansas subscriber-account page states $150 per year for the first 10 users and requires pre-activation.
access.api: No official business-entity API, unattended retrieval contract, or corporate-specific automation permission was established.
access.search: The separate official corporation search exposes Filing #, but search visibility does not establish the bulk schema, identifier lifecycle, or automation authority.

fields.summary: The SOS guide says listings of existing entities can be prepared by corporate type and include entity and registered-agent names and addresses. No public bulk schema, sample, exact headers, layout, row counts, byte counts, checksums, status codebook, address-role dictionary, or Filing # lifecycle is published. Registered-agent and natural-person fields must be excluded.

active_status_semantics: Registry existence, good standing, and any future bulk status values are administrative filing assertions, not proof of current business operation; no complete source status codebook is published.
statewide_completeness: The portal advertises database bulk downloads and list construction, but no exact population, included entity classes, complete-snapshot control total, or full-versus-delta semantics are published. Statewide completeness is not established.
address_zip: The guide mentions entity and registered-agent addresses, but it does not define a principal, mailing, or physical-site role or guarantee ZIP fields in the bulk product. Registered-agent and natural-person fields must be excluded; no retained address may be represented as a verified physical site.
automation_terms_fees: Published prices and cadences do not authorize enrollment, payment, automated retrieval, or recurring use. The FAQ and generic agreement do not establish corporate-product-specific automation, retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication, or redistribution rights.
redistribution: No reviewed official source grants retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication, or redistribution rights for the corporate bulk product or list-builder output.
temporal_refresh: Daily, weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly download options are advertised, but no full-versus-delta definitions, deletion/tombstone handling, correction or replay window, archive policy, record controls, checksums, or as-of semantics are published.

citations.evidence: Official Tyler portal product names, $2,000 monthly bulk subscription, advertised download cadences, and $0.10-per-record list builder with $10 minimum.
Official subscriber-account price and pre-activation requirement.
Official SOS guide describing existing-entity listings by corporate type and entity plus registered-agent names and addresses.
Official corporation search exposes Filing # but does not establish the bulk schema or identifier lifecycle.
Generic Arkansas agreement reviewed; it does not establish corporate-product-specific automation or downstream rights.

strongest_next_action: Obtain unsigned product-specific terms and a zero-row person-free schema or layout covering population, entity classes, Filing # lifecycle, status and address dictionaries, full/delta/deletion/replay controls, counts, checksums, supported unattended delivery, and retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication and redistribution rights before any payment or enrollment.
